source_passages.quotation: A player rules a clearing with more total **warriors plus buildings** than each other player. Tokens and pawns do not contribute. Ordinary ties mean nobody rules. Eyrie rule a tie for most if they have at least one Eyrie piece there. Vagabond cannot rule or stop someone else ruling.

answer.ruling: Rule by more warriors plus buildings than each other player; ties usually nobody, Eyrie wins ties with an Eyrie piece; tokens and pawns do not count, and Vagabond cannot rule or prevent rule.

source_passages.quotation: Take any positive number of your warriors/pawns from one clearing along a linking path to an adjacent clearing. You must rule origin or destination or both. Recheck rule for each move. You may move the same pieces repeatedly, including on multiple moves in one action. Rivers are not paths unless an effect explicitly treats them as paths.

answer.ruling: A positive group moves along a linking path to an adjacent clearing; rule origin, destination, or both, checking each move. Pieces can move repeatedly. Rivers are not paths absent an explicit exception.

source_passages.quotation: Resolve these six steps: Ambush; Before-roll effects; Roll; After-roll effects; Count hits; Deal hits. Defender may play one ambush matching clearing (birds are wild). Attacker may foil it with a matching ambush. Otherwise defender immediately deals two hits. If no attacking warriors or pawns remain, battle ends immediately. Each side’s rolled hits are capped by its own warriors in battle. Add extra hits (uncapped by warriors), subtract ignored hits. If defender has no warriors, attacker deals one extra hit for defenseless. Each hit removes one opposing piece; the side taking hits chooses its own removal order, but all its warriors must be removed before its buildings/tokens. Whoever removes an enemy building/token scores one VP each.

answer.ruling: Defender may ambush matching suit (birds wild); attacker may foil with matching ambush; otherwise two hits, and battle ends if attacker has no warriors/pawns. Before effects then dice (higher attacker, lower defender; equal equal; cap by warriors, with Alliance defense reversal and Vagabond swords), after effects, count extra hits and subtract ignored; defenseless adds attacker hit. Hit-taker chooses removals but warriors before buildings/tokens; both deal hits. Remover scores 1 VP per enemy building/token, including defender.

source_passages.quotation: Every crafting piece gets its suit from the clearing containing it. Marquise, Eyrie and Alliance pay one workshop, roost or sympathy per matching icon; each piece activates once per turn. Vagabond pawn may activate repeatedly, but each icon costs one face-up, undamaged hammer and its clearing must match every icon. An item card requires the corresponding item token in map supply. Only an identical persistent effect in your own play area prevents crafting it again.

answer.ruling: Costs are one eligible faction crafting piece per icon, each at its clearing suit and each usable once per turn for the three factions; Vagabond pawn may be reused but pays one face-up undamaged hammer per icon and clearing must match every icon. Item card needs corresponding supply token. Identical persistent effect already in own play area blocks duplicate crafting.

source_passages.quotation: In own Daylight at at least 10 VP, activate dominance from hand into play area; remove score marker and stop scoring VP. At start of own Birdsong, win if ruling three clearings of matching mouse/rabbit/fox suit, or for bird dominance, two diagonally opposite corner clearings. Cannot remove/replace activated card.

answer.ruling: Activate during own Daylight at 10+ VP. At start of own Birdsong, win by ruling three clearings of matching suit, or two opposite corners for bird. Activated card cannot be removed/replaced; stop VP scoring.

source_passages.quotation: Whenever one would enter discard, put it near map available instead. During own Daylight, spend matching card to take available dominance into hand. Available bird dominance remains bird, so payment must be bird; a bird hand card can pay for non-bird dominance. Activation and taking are separate, neither requires a faction action allowance.

answer.ruling: A dominance card sent to discard instead goes near map available. During own Daylight spend a matching card to take an available dominance into hand; bird dominance remains bird and requires bird payment. Taking and activation are separate and do not use faction action allowance.

source_passages.quotation: With two players, remove all four dominance cards. Shuffle shared deck; each player draws three cards. Cover four R building slots with ruins. Map supply is 2 boots, 2 bags, 1 crossbow, 1 hammer, 2 swords, 2 tea, 2 coins. Only Vagabond setup hides one each R-marked bag, boot, hammer and sword under the ruins, one each; without Vagabond ruins contain no items. Set up factions Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond; setup order is distinct from turn order.

answer.ruling: Two players remove all four dominance cards; shuffle shared deck and each draw three. Cover four R slots with ruins; item supply listed separately, and only Vagabond setup hides R-marked bag, boot, hammer, sword one beneath each shuffled ruin; without Vagabond empty. Faction setup order Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond.

source_passages.quotation: Only Marquise may place pieces in its clearing; others may move pieces into it. Whenever any number Marquise warriors are removed from a clearing, Marquise may spend one card matching that clearing to place them in keep clearing instead of supply. This can apply outside battle. Keep cannot be placed again if removed.

answer.ruling: Only Marquise may place pieces in keep clearing; others may move into it. Hospitals: when any Marquise warriors removed, may spend one matching clearing card to put them in keep instead of supply; can apply outside battle. Keep cannot be placed again once removed.

source_passages.quotation: First craft with workshops. Then take up to three actions plus one per bird card spent outside an action, in any order, except Recruit limit. March is up to two moves, not interruptible. Recruit places one warrior at each recruiter and is once per turn. Overwork spends a card matching a sawmill clearing to place one wood there.

answer.ruling: Daylight craft with workshops first, then up to 3 actions plus one per bird spent outside an action. March up to two moves as one compound action. Recruit one per recruiter once per turn. Overwork discards card matching sawmill clearing to place one wood there.

source_passages.quotation: Choose a clearing you rule with open slot and building type. Take leftmost building of that type. Pay column cost by removing wood from target or other ruled clearings linked to it through an unbroken chain of ruled clearings. Place building; score VP on uncovered space. Full cost, building and legal slot are required.

answer.ruling: Build in clearing you rule, open slot; choose type, take leftmost building; pay column wood cost from target clearing or linked chain of ruled clearings; place and score uncovered space VP. Cannot build without full cost, building, slot.

source_passages.quotation: Birdsong: Emergency Orders, if hand empty draw one; Add to Decree one or two hand cards, at most one bird; A New Roost if no roosts, place one roost and three warriors in a clearing with fewest warriors where all these pieces can be placed.

answer.ruling: Emergency Orders draw one only if hand empty; add 1–2 cards, at most one bird, any columns; if no roosts place one roost and three warriors in fewest-warriors clearing where all fit.

source_passages.quotation: Craft using roosts first, then every Decree card, column by column Recruit → Move → Battle → Build; within a column choose order freely. Recruit matches clearing with roost, places one warrior there (Charismatic two); Move matches origin and moves at least one warrior obeying normal requirements; Battle matches battle clearing; Build matches target, place roost in clearing you rule with open slot and no roost. Birds wild. If any action cannot be fully completed, immediately Turmoil.

answer.ruling: Craft with roosts then resolve all cards Recruit→Move→Battle→Build; order within column free. Recruit suit at roost, one (Charismatic two); Move suit origin, at least one warrior under normal rules; Battle suit battle clearing; Build suit target, ruled clearing, open slot, no roost. Bird wild. Cannot fully complete => Turmoil immediately.

source_passages.quotation: Turmoil: lose one VP per bird Decree card including both Loyal Viziers; discard every Decree card except Viziers; flip current leader face down and choose face-up replacement, flipping all leaders face up if none; retuck Viziers. End Daylight and proceed to normal Evening: score roost track, draw one plus uncovered bonuses, discard to five. Turmoil does not remove map warriors/buildings.

answer.ruling: Lose 1 VP per bird Decree card including Viziers; discard all Decree except Viziers; flip leader and choose face-up replacement (turn all up if none); retuck Viziers; map pieces stay. End Daylight; full normal Evening score roost, draw plus bonuses, discard to five.

source_passages.quotation: Each time another player removes sympathy or moves any warriors into sympathetic clearing, add one matching hand card (birds count) to Supporters; one per affected move. If no matching cards including birds, show hand to Alliance, then Alliance draws one deck card. If Supporters full discard incoming Outrage card; payment or no-match draw still occurs.

answer.ruling: Removing sympathy or moving any warriors into sympathetic clearing triggers one matching hand card (birds count) per affected move, not warrior. If no matching card show hand, Alliance draws one. Full supporter stack means incoming Outrage card discarded; payment/no-match draw still occurs.

source_passages.quotation: Both Revolt and Spread Sympathy in Birdsong; complete all Revolts before Spread. Every supporter spent must match target, birds wild. Revolt: sympathetic clearing without base matching a base on board; spend two; remove all enemy pieces, score enemy buildings/tokens, place matching base, warriors equal sympathetic clearings matching base suit, one Officer. Spread: unsympathetic clearing adjacent by path to sympathy, or any clearing if none; spend cost shown above next token; add one matching supporter for Martial Law if chosen clearing has at least three warriors of one other player; place token and score uncovered space.

answer.ruling: Both in Birdsong; finish all Revolts before any Spread. Revolt target sympathetic, no base, matching base available; spend 2 matching supporters; clear enemy pieces, score buildings/tokens, place base, warriors equal matching-suit sympathies, one officer. Spread unsympathetic adjacent to sympathy, or any if none; pay printed next-token cost matching target; Martial Law +1 if 3+ warriors of one other player; place and score.

source_passages.quotation: Train during Daylight: spend hand card matching clearing with base to place supply warrior in Officers; Supporters cannot pay. Evening take up to number of officers operations; operations do not consume officers. Organize removes one Alliance warrior from unsympathetic clearing, places sympathy there, scores uncovered VP. Losing base discards supporters matching its clearing including birds and removes half officers rounded up; if no bases remain discard supporters down to five.

answer.ruling: Train in Daylight: hand card matching clearing with base, place supply warrior in Officers; Supporters cannot pay. Evening up to officer-count operations; officers not consumed. Organize removes Alliance warrior from unsympathetic clearing, places sympathy, scores uncovered VP. Losing base discards matching supporters including birds and removes half officers rounded up; with no bases cap supporters at 5.

source_passages.quotation: Refresh counts tea already face up on track: flip two exhausted items per tea, then three; tea refreshed now gives no extra. Slip moves to adjacent clearing/forest, no boots, ignores effects preventing movement out. Daylight Move exhausts one boot and one extra if destination has any Hostile faction warriors; cannot enter forest, from forest only to adjacent clearing. Forest Rest returns damaged items to Satchel and flips them face up; Evening always draws one plus face-up coins.

answer.ruling: Refresh: count face-up tea on Refresh, flip 2 items per tea plus 3; newly refreshed tea no bonus. Slip optional adjacent clearing/forest free boots and ignores outbound movement prevention. Normal move exhaust boot + extra if any Hostile faction warriors at destination; cannot enter forest; forest only to clearing. Forest Rest returns damaged items, flips them face up; Evening always draws 1 + face-up coins.

source_passages.quotation: Explore exhaust torch in ruin clearing, take hidden item face up into Satchel/track, score one VP if taken; remove ruin when last item taken, freeing slot. Quest matching clearing: exhaust two listed items, complete quest; choose VP equal matching completed quests including it or draw two cards; draw replacement quest. Repair exhaust hammer and move damaged item to Satchel keeping current face; ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if space.

answer.ruling: Explore exhaust torch in ruin clearing; take hidden item face up and score 1 VP; remove ruin when last item taken. Quest in matching clearing exhaust two listed items; choose VP equal matching completed quests including this one, or draw 2; replace quest. Repair exhaust hammer, move damaged item to Satchel preserving face; ready tea/coins/bags go to tracks if space.

source_passages.quotation: Removing one warrior of non-Hostile faction immediately makes marker Hostile. On own turn battle, score one extra VP per hostile piece removed except warrior that first caused Hostile; no Infamy other player’s turn or from Strike. Aid cannot move marker out of Hostile. Strike exhaust crossbow to remove one enemy warrior; only if enemy has no warriors there may remove another faction piece.

answer.ruling: Removing one warrior of non-Hostile faction makes it Hostile immediately. On own-turn battle Infamy +1 per Hostile piece removed except first warrior that caused hostility; no Infamy another turn or Strike. Aid cannot undo Hostility. Strike exhaust crossbow to remove warrior, only if no warriors there may target another faction piece.

source_passages.quotation: With four or more players, in own Daylight at at least 10 VP activate dominance to coalition with another player not already in coalition whose VP is lowest among players other than you (choose ties). Put marker on partner board and stop scoring. If partner wins, you win including dominance. Hostile partner becomes Indifferent.

answer.ruling: With 4+ players, Vagabond Daylight at 10+ VP coalition with non-coalition player lowest VP among others (choose ties); marker on partner board, stop scoring; partner win means Vagabond wins, including dominance. Hostile partner becomes Indifferent.

source_passages.quotation: Card overrides Law, Law overrides Learning to Play; faction rules prevail when incompatible with general rules; Cannot is absolute unless explicitly overridden.

answer.ruling: Card overrides Law, Law overrides Learning to Play; faction rules prevail when incompatible with general rules; Cannot is absolute unless explicitly overridden.

source_passages.quotation: For simultaneous effects without clear order/decision-maker, current player chooses. Attacker orders simultaneous battle timing effects. March two moves are one compound action and cannot be interrupted to spend bird/take another action.

answer.ruling: For simultaneous effects without clear order/decision-maker, current player chooses. Attacker orders simultaneous battle timing effects. March two moves are one compound action and cannot be interrupted to spend bird/take another action.

source_passages.quotation: At-start precedes all phase effects; at-end follows all effects of that phase before next phase. Once last step of turn begins, no other actions except explicitly end-of-Evening/turn actions.

answer.ruling: At-start precedes all phase effects; at-end follows all effects of that phase before next phase. Once last step of turn begins, no other actions except explicitly end-of-Evening/turn actions.

source_passages.quotation: Hand size public, contents private; reveal only if instructed. Face-up piles inspectable; deck not. Agreements nonbinding; card transfer only as instructed; actions require no consent.

answer.ruling: Hand size public, contents private; reveal only if instructed. Face-up piles inspectable; deck not. Agreements nonbinding; card transfer only as instructed; actions require no consent.

source_passages.quotation: When deck empties, immediately shuffle discard into new deck. Birds substitute for any non-bird suit, including multiple same-suit payments; forced non-bird discard treats birds as that suit. Explicit bird requirement requires bird card.

answer.ruling: When deck empties, immediately shuffle discard into new deck. Birds substitute for any non-bird suit, including multiple same-suit payments; forced non-bird discard treats birds as that suit. Explicit bird requirement requires bird card.

source_passages.quotation: Must do maximum possible, cannot use proxies or voluntarily do fewer; shortages do not waive costs/prerequisites or Eyrie duty to complete Decree actions.

answer.ruling: Must do maximum possible, cannot use proxies or voluntarily do fewer; shortages do not waive costs/prerequisites or Eyrie duty to complete Decree actions.

source_passages.quotation: Place from supply or leftmost track; remove to supply/rightmost empty track. Removed items permanently removed. Simultaneous removals all occur before removal effects trigger.

answer.ruling: Place from supply or leftmost track; remove to supply/rightmost empty track. Removed items permanently removed. Simultaneous removals all occur before removal effects trigger.

source_passages.quotation: Forced action resolved as if affected player chose it, retaining their abilities/restrictions; forced player makes battle decisions.

answer.ruling: Forced action resolved as if affected player chose it, retaining their abilities/restrictions; forced player makes battle decisions.

source_passages.quotation: Replace requires removal and placement possible; Keep placement ban cannot be bypassed by replacing enemy piece. Swap ignores move/place restrictions.

answer.ruling: Replace requires removal and placement possible; Keep placement ban cannot be bypassed by replacing enemy piece. Swap ignores move/place restrictions.

source_passages.quotation: If multiple reach 30 simultaneously, tied player closest clockwise to current player wins, including current player.

answer.ruling: If multiple reach 30 simultaneously, tied player closest clockwise to current player wins, including current player.

source_passages.quotation: Forest adjacent to clearings touching it without crossing printed path and forests separated by one printed path; Winter river divides forests too. Fall has no special rules.

answer.ruling: Forest adjacent to clearings touching it without crossing printed path and forests separated by one printed path; Winter river divides forests too. Fall has no special rules.

source_passages.quotation: Marquise supply 25 warriors, 8 wood; Keep any corner; one warrior each clearing except diagonal opposite corner. One each building among Keep and adjacent clearings respecting slots; remaining five each type on tracks right-to-left, leftmost empty.

answer.ruling: Marquise supply 25 warriors, 8 wood; Keep any corner; one warrior each clearing except diagonal opposite corner. One each building among Keep and adjacent clearings respecting slots; remaining five each type on tracks right-to-left, leftmost empty.

source_passages.quotation: Eyrie supply 20; one roost and six warriors in corner not another starting corner, opposite if possible. Choose leader; tuck two bird Viziers in its listed columns; other six roosts on track right-to-left.

answer.ruling: Eyrie supply 20; one roost and six warriors in corner not another starting corner, opposite if possible. Choose leader; tuck two bird Viziers in its listed columns; other six roosts on track right-to-left.

source_passages.quotation: Alliance supply 10 warriors; put three bases on matching board spaces and ten sympathy on track; draw three additional cards face down into Supporters besides three-card hand; no map pieces or officers.

answer.ruling: Alliance supply 10 warriors; put three bases on matching board spaces and ten sympathy on track; draw three additional cards face down into Supporters besides three-card hand; no map pieces or officers.

source_passages.quotation: Choose Thief/Tinker/Ranger; pawn in any forest; shuffle quests/display three face-up; relationship markers Indifferent. Starting S items per character: tea/coins/bags on matching tracks, other items face-up Satchel; unused S items box.

answer.ruling: Choose Thief/Tinker/Ranger; pawn in any forest; shuffle quests/display three face-up; relationship markers Indifferent. Starting S items per character: tea/coins/bags on matching tracks, other items face-up Satchel; unused S items box.

source_passages.quotation: Minimum Reach 17 for two, 18 for three, 21 for four. Base values Marquise 10, Eyrie 7, Vagabond 5, Alliance 3; adventurous mixes at least 17.

answer.ruling: Minimum Reach 17 for two, 18 for three, 21 for four. Base values Marquise 10, Eyrie 7, Vagabond 5, Alliance 3; adventurous mixes at least 17.

source_passages.quotation: Birdsong one wood per sawmill (per sawmill even shared clearing); Daylight Overwork spends matching card to add one wood. Both draw from finite eight. Evening draw one plus uncovered bonuses, discard to five.

answer.ruling: Birdsong one wood per sawmill (per sawmill even shared clearing); Daylight Overwork spends matching card to add one wood. Both draw from finite eight. Evening draw one plus uncovered bonuses, discard to five.

source_passages.quotation: Place maximum available warriors among eligible recruiters, Marquise chooses recruiters; one per recruiter, and Recruit once per turn.

answer.ruling: Place maximum available warriors among eligible recruiters, Marquise chooses recruiters; one per recruiter, and Recruit once per turn.

source_passages.quotation: Eyrie crafted items score one VP instead of printed due Disdain; Builder ignores Disdain. Other extra crafting-point effects still apply.

answer.ruling: Eyrie crafted items score one VP instead of printed due Disdain; Builder ignores Disdain. Other extra crafting-point effects still apply.

source_passages.quotation: Builder Recruit/Move, ignores Disdain; Charismatic Recruit/Battle, recruits two; Commander Move/Battle, extra attacker hit; Despot Move/Build, extra VP when battle removes enemy building/token.

answer.ruling: Builder Recruit/Move, ignores Disdain; Charismatic Recruit/Battle, recruits two; Commander Move/Battle, extra attacker hit; Despot Move/Build, extra VP when battle removes enemy building/token.

source_passages.quotation: No. Charismatic must place two; if required action cannot be fully completed, Turmoil immediately.

answer.ruling: No. Charismatic must place two; if required action cannot be fully completed, Turmoil immediately.

source_passages.quotation: Warrior caps still apply. Alliance defending reverses dice: higher die Alliance hits, lower attacker.

answer.ruling: Warrior caps still apply. Alliance defending reverses dice: higher die Alliance hits, lower attacker.

source_passages.quotation: Supporters only spend for suit, inspectable by Alliance, not hand cards or hand limit; craft from hand only.

answer.ruling: Supporters only spend for suit, inspectable by Alliance, not hand cards or hand limit; craft from hand only.

source_passages.quotation: No. All Revolts before spreading; cannot return to Revolt once Spread begins.

answer.ruling: No. All Revolts before spreading; cannot return to Revolt once Spread begins.

source_passages.quotation: No: Martial Law needs three warriors of one other player. Organize has no supporter, adjacency or Martial Law cost.

answer.ruling: No: Martial Law needs three warriors of one other player. Organize has no supporter, adjacency or Martial Law cost.

source_passages.quotation: Placing warriors and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger Outrage; allied warriors moved into sympathy do trigger Outrage.

answer.ruling: Placing warriors and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger Outrage; allied warriors moved into sympathy do trigger Outrage.

source_passages.quotation: Move, Battle, Recruit, Organize; up to number officers, any order/repetition. Officers remain. Draw after operations: one + uncovered bonuses then discard to five.

answer.ruling: Move, Battle, Recruit, Organize; up to number officers, any order/repetition. Officers remain. Draw after operations: one + uncovered bonuses then discard to five.

source_passages.quotation: Pawn cannot be removed; when an effect removes all enemy pieces there, Vagabond instead damages three items.

answer.ruling: Pawn cannot be removed; when an effect removes all enemy pieces there, Vagabond instead damages three items.

source_passages.quotation: Maximum rolled hits is all undamaged swords, face up or down; defenseless only with none undamaged. Excess hits damage undamaged items of choice; ignore when none remain.

answer.ruling: Maximum rolled hits is all undamaged swords, face up or down; defenseless only with none undamaged. Excess hits damage undamaged items of choice; ignore when none remain.

source_passages.quotation: Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel move to empty matching track if possible; each track max three. Exhausting track item sends to Satchel. Damaging preserves face; damaged items cannot pay actions.

answer.ruling: Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel move to empty matching track if possible; each track max three. Exhausting track item sends to Satchel. Damaging preserves face; damaged items cannot pay actions.

source_passages.quotation: Satchel plus Damaged box max six plus two per face-up bag on track; track items excluded. Check last Evening step after drawing/discarding; permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until within limit.

answer.ruling: Satchel plus Damaged box max six plus two per face-up bag on track; track items excluded. Check last Evening step after drawing/discarding; permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until within limit.

source_passages.quotation: Rest returns damaged items to Satchel and flips them face-up; does not refresh undamaged exhausted items. Refresh flips exhausted items according to tea then three; Repair exhaust hammer and moves one damaged item to Satchel preserving face.

answer.ruling: Rest returns damaged items to Satchel and flips them face-up; does not refresh undamaged exhausted items. Refresh flips exhausted items according to tea then three; Repair exhaust hammer and moves one damaged item to Satchel preserving face.

source_passages.quotation: Exhaust one face-up undamaged item of any type; give matching-clearing card to player with faction pieces there, even Hostile. May take crafted item, but none required. To advance relationship, Aid required number times in same turn; each Aid counts only one improvement.

answer.ruling: Exhaust one face-up undamaged item of any type; give matching-clearing card to player with faction pieces there, even Hostile. May take crafted item, but none required. To advance relationship, Aid required number times in same turn; each Aid counts only one improvement.

source_passages.quotation: Allied Aid scores 2 VP; may move one faction’s warriors with pawn subject to their movement rules; at battle start as attacker may use one allied faction’s warriors as own to raise rolled-hit maximum. Cannot attack that ally.

answer.ruling: Allied Aid scores 2 VP; may move one faction’s warriors with pawn subject to their movement rules; at battle start as attacker may use one allied faction’s warriors as own to raise rolled-hit maximum. Cannot attack that ally.

source_passages.quotation: At battle end ally becomes Hostile if Vagabond removes more allied warriors than items damaged in that battle; equal does not trigger.

answer.ruling: At battle end ally becomes Hostile if Vagabond removes more allied warriors than items damaged in that battle; equal does not trigger.

source_passages.quotation: Cannot pay mixed fox/rabbit icons from one clearing. Pawn reusable, but hammer per icon. Crafted item may immediately be taken and used in another Daylight action if cost/requirements met.

answer.ruling: Cannot pay mixed fox/rabbit icons from one clearing. Pawn reusable, but hammer per icon. Crafted item may immediately be taken and used in another Daylight action if cost/requirements met.

source_passages.quotation: Thief boot, torch, tea, sword: Steal exhaust torch, random hand card from player with faction pieces in clearing. Tinker boot, torch, bag, hammer: Day Labor torch, take discard card matching clearing (bird qualifies). Ranger boot, torch, crossbow, sword: Hideout torch, repair three preserving faces, end Daylight/start Evening.

answer.ruling: Thief boot, torch, tea, sword: Steal exhaust torch, random hand card from player with faction pieces in clearing. Tinker boot, torch, bag, hammer: Day Labor torch, take discard card matching clearing (bird qualifies). Ranger boot, torch, crossbow, sword: Hideout torch, repair three preserving faces, end Daylight/start Evening.

source_passages.quotation: When last ruin item taken, remove ruin and free building slot. Ruins can be removed only when explicitly allowed; ordinary building placement cannot remove it.

answer.ruling: When last ruin item taken, remove ruin and free building slot. Ruins can be removed only when explicitly allowed; ordinary building placement cannot remove it.

source_passages.quotation: Coalition partners are not enemies and cannot be attacked as enemy. Coalition itself grants no Allied relationship powers.

answer.ruling: Coalition partners are not enemies and cannot be attacked as enemy. Coalition itself grants no Allied relationship powers.

source_passages.quotation: Removing two warriors gets 0 ordinary removal VP each; first warrior makes faction Hostile and gives no Infamy, second hostile warrior gives 1 Infamy; building gives 1 removal VP plus 1 Infamy = 2. Total 3 VP.

answer.ruling: Removing two warriors gets 0 ordinary removal VP each; first warrior makes faction Hostile and gives no Infamy, second hostile warrior gives 1 Infamy; building gives 1 removal VP plus 1 Infamy = 2. Total 3 VP.

source_passages.quotation: Hostile buildings alone cost one boot. Any hostile warriors at destination require one extra boot total, regardless of how many Hostile factions.

answer.ruling: Hostile buildings alone cost one boot. Any hostile warriors at destination require one extra boot total, regardless of how many Hostile factions.

source_passages.quotation: No, taking puts card in hand; activation is separate. Neither taking nor activating uses Marquise action allowance.

answer.ruling: No, taking puts card in hand; activation is separate. Neither taking nor activating uses Marquise action allowance.

source_passages.quotation: Faction-piece ownership cannot change; items are not faction pieces or enemy pieces, and holding does not confer faction ownership.

answer.ruling: Faction-piece ownership cannot change; items are not faction pieces or enemy pieces, and holding does not confer faction ownership.

source_passages.quotation: Immediate card resolves then is discarded; persistent card stays play area. A play-area card cannot be spent/discarded/used as hand unless explicitly instructed.

answer.ruling: Immediate card resolves then is discarded; persistent card stays play area. A play-area card cannot be spent/discarded/used as hand unless explicitly instructed.

source_passages.quotation: Neither can be crafted. Ambush used by defender for two hits or attacker to foil matching defense ambush. Dominance activated to change win condition or spent for suit.

answer.ruling: Neither can be crafted. Ambush used by defender for two hits or attacker to foil matching defense ambush. Dominance activated to change win condition or spent for suit.

source_passages.quotation: Choose starting player/seating randomly; score markers at 0; dice nearby. Faction setup order Marquise/Eyrie/Alliance/Vagabond is distinct from turn order.

answer.ruling: Choose starting player/seating randomly; score markers at 0; dice nearby. Faction setup order Marquise/Eyrie/Alliance/Vagabond is distinct from turn order.

source_passages.quotation: 30 VP wins immediately, any player turn; no need to finish action/phase/turn.

answer.ruling: 30 VP wins immediately, any player turn; no need to finish action/phase/turn.

source_passages.quotation: Choose clearing with your warriors or pawn and enemy defender there; no need to rule clearing.

answer.ruling: Choose clearing with your warriors or pawn and enemy defender there; no need to rule clearing.

source_passages.quotation: Attacker chooses order for before-roll and after-roll effects when both sides have them. Each side chooses order of effects triggered by its own pieces removal.

answer.ruling: Attacker chooses order for before-roll and after-roll effects when both sides have them. Each side chooses order of effects triggered by its own pieces removal.

source_passages.quotation: Add extra hits uncapped by warriors, then subtract ignored hits.

answer.ruling: Add extra hits uncapped by warriors, then subtract ignored hits.

source_passages.quotation: Item token from map item supply to crafting faction Crafted Items box; usual score is card printed VP, except Eyrie one VP.

answer.ruling: Item token from map item supply to crafting faction Crafted Items box; usual score is card printed VP, except Eyrie one VP.

source_passages.quotation: Eyrie activates roosts, Alliance sympathy; piece suit comes from clearing. Three-color question-mark accepts any suit.

answer.ruling: Eyrie activates roosts, Alliance sympathy; piece suit comes from clearing. Three-color question-mark accepts any suit.

source_passages.quotation: Mobilize adds one hand card to Supporters; no bases cap at five with overflow discarded, any base unlimited. Craft/Mobilize/Train any order and number.

answer.ruling: Mobilize adds one hand card to Supporters; no bases cap at five with overflow discarded, any base unlimited. Craft/Mobilize/Train any order and number.

source_passages.quotation: Score VP on rightmost empty roost track space; draw one plus uncovered bonuses, discard to five. Happens after Turmoil too.

answer.ruling: Score VP on rightmost empty roost track space; draw one plus uncovered bonuses, discard to five. Happens after Turmoil too.

source_passages.quotation: Exhaust one sword. Exhausted sword cannot pay though undamaged swords (face up or down) count toward hit limit.

source_passages.quotation: Birdsong→Daylight→Evening clockwise; after Evening next player clockwise takes turn.

source_passages.quotation: One hit damages one undamaged item chosen, moves it to Damaged box preserving face; already damaged items cannot absorb hits; excess ignored if no undamaged items.

source_passages.quotation: Up to number officers. One Recruit operation places one warrior at one clearing with a base.

source_passages.quotation: No fixed order; any order/number as ready undamaged items permit, so same action type may repeat.
